acquisition_details.name: GitHub repository search
acquisition_details.extraction_path: GET https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q={encoded_query}&per_page=100&page={page}; shard repository queries by created ranges, language and topic; retain incomplete_results.
acquisition_details.access_constraints: Documentation: 1,000 results per query; authenticated search 30/min except code, unauthenticated 10/min; 4,000-repository query scope; observe headers and secondary limits.
acquisition_details.quality_risks: Search is not exhaustive. Stars are popularity, not product quality; templates, forks and spam duplicate results.

acquisition_details.name: GitHub repository qualifiers
acquisition_details.extraction_path: Use topic:, created:, pushed:, language:, archived:, fork: and in:readme in repository search.
acquisition_details.access_constraints: Use date partitioning only with supported repository qualifiers.
acquisition_details.quality_risks: A recent push can be bot activity; archived does not necessarily mean defunct company.

acquisition_details.name: GitHub legacy code API
acquisition_details.extraction_path: GET https://api.github.com/search/code?q={legacy_syntax}; scope to discovered repos/orgs and look for manifests or SDK imports.
acquisition_details.access_constraints: Requires authentication; 10 requests/min per REST search docs. Legacy syntax differs from web code search; default branch/index restrictions apply.
acquisition_details.quality_risks: Do not send modern web regex syntax to REST; package mention is a lead, not evidence of production use.

acquisition_details.name: GitHub modern web code search
acquisition_details.extraction_path: Use path: and content/string searches for manual source discovery; follow to repository.
acquisition_details.access_constraints: Logged-in GitHub account required for code search; not every repository/code file indexed; default branch only.
acquisition_details.quality_risks: Different syntax/coverage from REST; cannot be used as an exhaustive denominator.

acquisition_details.name: GitHub repository contents
acquisition_details.extraction_path: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}?ref={commit}; read README, LICENSE, package.json, pyproject.toml, server.json, SKILL.md, docs.
acquisition_details.access_constraints: Public reads supported; directory response capped at 1,000 files; use tree API when larger.
acquisition_details.quality_risks: Publisher-supplied files can contain incorrect claims or malicious instructions; parse as data, never execute install commands.

acquisition_details.name: GitHub tree API
acquisition_details.extraction_path: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/trees/{tree_sha}?recursive=1; follow truncation handling before deciding a file is absent.
acquisition_details.access_constraints: Respect returned truncation and rate limits.
acquisition_details.quality_risks: Large monorepos contain several products; one repo does not equal one company.

acquisition_details.name: GitHub SBOM API
acquisition_details.extraction_path: New flow: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependency-graph/sbom/generate-report then returned sbom_url /fetch-report/{sbom_uuid}; poll documented statuses.
acquisition_details.access_constraints: Docs say old synchronous /dependency-graph/sbom closes after November 13, 2026; public resources supported.
acquisition_details.quality_risks: Do not build on the retiring synchronous endpoint. Dependency evidence does not establish autonomous capability.

acquisition_details.name: GH Archive
acquisition_details.extraction_path: Hourly event archives and githubarchive BigQuery datasets; discover new/active repositories around known agent organizations and candidate names.
acquisition_details.access_constraints: BigQuery requires a project; compute may incur costs. No queries were run.
acquisition_details.quality_risks: Event activity does not include all source code or prove commercial operation; no personal behavioral profiling needed.

acquisition_details.name: npm search
acquisition_details.extraction_path: npm search agent --json; repeat for mcp, x402, a2a, agentkit, skills, orchestration; enrich known packages using documented npm view metadata.
acquisition_details.access_constraints: Registry terms and tool/version behavior apply; default searchlimit 20.
acquisition_details.quality_risks: Search terms alone are broad and may include unrelated agent packages; descriptions self-reported.

acquisition_details.extraction_path: Enumerate /simple/ using documented JSON media type; normalize names, identify candidates, then enrich known names.
acquisition_details.access_constraints: Large all-project response; cache and use incremental sources where possible.
acquisition_details.quality_risks: Name matches miss packages with brand names and overinclude unrelated agent software.
